
```{r}
# GSE234729: African ancestry, severe preeclampsia (sPE) vs Control
# ADAPTED FROM: deseq2_pipeline_continued(2).R (classroom script)
# IMPORTANT: uploaded file is already DESeq2-normalized, not raw integer counts.
# We keep the SAME step order and variable names from class wherever possible.
# PCA/plots use log2(normalized counts + 1); testing uses exploratory limma.
# Do NOT run DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(), DESeq(), or lfcShrink() on these values.

############################################################
# Step 0: Install/load packages
############################################################
if (!requireNamespace('BiocManager', quietly=TRUE)) install.packages('BiocManager')
for (p in c('GEOquery', 'limma')) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly=TRUE)) BiocManager::install(p, update=FALSE, ask=FALSE)
}
for (p in c('ggplot2', 'pheatmap', 'ggrepel')) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly=TRUE)) install.packages(p)
}
library(GEOquery)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggrepel)

############################################################
# Step 1: Load the expression matrix (same role as counts in class)
############################################################
# Put the .txt data file in the RStudio working directory.
input_file <- 'GSE234729_Plac_samples_diff_ancestry_Deseq2_norm_filtered.txt'
stopifnot(file.exists(input_file))
counts <- read.table(input_file, header=TRUE, row.names=1,
                     sep='\t', check.names=FALSE, quote='', comment.char='')
counts <- as.matrix(counts)
storage.mode(counts) <- 'numeric'
stopifnot(!anyNA(counts), all(counts >= 0), !anyDuplicated(colnames(counts)))
head(counts[, 1:4])
dim(counts)
# NOTE: Name kept from class, but 'counts' contains NORMALIZED values here.

############################################################
############################################################
# Step 2: Create Sample Metadata (coldata, as in class)
# African Ancestry: Control vs Severe Preeclampsia
############################################################

# Load GEO metadata
library(GEOquery)

gse <- getGEO("GSE234729",
              GSEMatrix = TRUE,
              getGPL = FALSE)

geo <- if (is.list(gse)) gse[[1]] else gse

geo_info <- Biobase::pData(geo)

# View metadata column names
colnames(geo_info)

# Identify sample characteristics
char_cols <- grep(
  "^characteristics_ch1",
  colnames(geo_info),
  value = TRUE
)

# Function to extract sample information
get_field <- function(data, pattern) {
  
  vapply(seq_len(nrow(data)), function(i) {
    
    entry <- unlist(
      data[i, char_cols, drop = FALSE],
      use.names = FALSE
    )
    
    entry <- entry[!is.na(entry)]
    
    hit <- grep(
      pattern,
      entry,
      ignore.case = TRUE,
      value = TRUE
    )
    
    if (length(hit) == 0) {
      return(NA_character_)
    }
    
    trimws(sub("^[^:]+:", "", hit[1]))
    
  }, character(1))
}

############################################################
# Create metadata dataframe
############################################################

coldata <- data.frame(
  
  sample = trimws(as.character(geo_info$title)),
  
  ancestry = get_field(
    geo_info,
    "maternal_ancestry_self_report"
  ),
  
  disease = get_field(
    geo_info,
    "^disease:"
  ),
  
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Check ancestry and disease labels
table(coldata$ancestry, useNA = "ifany")
table(coldata$disease, useNA = "ifany")

############################################################
# Select African ancestry samples
############################################################

# Keep samples present in the expression matrix
coldata <- subset(
  coldata,
  sample %in% colnames(counts) &
    ancestry == "African"
)

# Assign control and sPE groups
coldata$condition <- ifelse(
  
  coldata$disease == "Severe Preeclampsia",
  "sPE",
  
  ifelse(
    coldata$disease == "Non-hypertensive control",
    "Control",
    NA
  )
)

# Check sample assignments
print(coldata)

# Remove samples with unrecognized conditions
coldata <- coldata[!is.na(coldata$condition), ]

# Set control as the reference group
coldata$condition <- factor(
  coldata$condition,
  levels = c("Control", "sPE")
)

############################################################
# Check sample numbers
############################################################

table(coldata$condition)

# Expected:
# Control = 10
# sPE = 6

stopifnot(
  sum(coldata$condition == "Control") == 10,
  sum(coldata$condition == "sPE") == 6
)

############################################################
# Match metadata with expression matrix
############################################################

# Use sample names as row names
rownames(coldata) <- coldata$sample

# Keep only the selected samples in expression data
counts <- counts[, rownames(coldata), drop = FALSE]

# Confirm sample names match
stopifnot(
  identical(colnames(counts), rownames(coldata))
)

############################################################
# Save sample information
############################################################

write.csv(
  coldata,
  "GSE234729_African_sample_metadata.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

############################################################
# Final verification
############################################################

cat("Step 2 completed successfully!\n")

cat("African Controls:",
    sum(coldata$condition == "Control"), "\n")

cat("African sPE:",
    sum(coldata$condition == "sPE"), "\n")

cat("Total Samples:", ncol(counts), "\n")

############################################################
# Step 3: Check data instead of making a DESeq2 dataset
############################################################
# In class: dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=counts, ...)
# NOT APPROPRIATE HERE because uploaded counts are noninteger normalized values.
summary(as.vector(counts))

############################################################
# Step 4: Normalized counts (already normalized by original authors)
############################################################
# In class: dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
# In this GEO file, normalization has ALREADY been performed.
normalized_counts <- counts
head(normalized_counts[,1:4])

############################################################
# Step 5: Raw vs normalized boxplot (only normalized available)
############################################################
boxplot(log2(normalized_counts + 1), main='Normalized Gene Expression',
        ylab='log2(normalized counts + 1)', las=2, cex.axis=.6)
# Raw-count boxplot cannot be generated from the provided file.

############################################################
# Step 6: Transformation for PCA (vsd role from class)
############################################################
# In class: vsd <- vst(dds)
# Here: a log2 transform for exploratory plots, NOT DESeq2 VST.
vsd <- log2(normalized_counts + 1)

############################################################
# Step 7: PCA plot (same concept as class)
############################################################
pca <- prcomp(t(vsd), center=TRUE)
pca_data <- data.frame(name=rownames(pca$x), condition=coldata$condition,
                       PC1=pca$x[,1], PC2=pca$x[,2])
percentVar <- round(100*summary(pca)$importance[2,1:2], 1)
p_pca <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1,PC2,color=condition)) +
  geom_point(size=4) + geom_text_repel(aes(label=name), max.overlaps=30) +
  xlab(paste0('PC1: ',percentVar[1],'% variance')) +
  ylab(paste0('PC2: ',percentVar[2],'% variance')) +
  ggtitle('PCA: African ancestry sPE vs Control') + theme_minimal()
print(p_pca)
ggsave('African_PCA.png', p_pca, width=8,height=6,dpi=300)

############################################################
# Step 8: Sample-to-sample distance heatmap (same as class)
############################################################
sampleDists <- dist(t(vsd))
sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix(sampleDists)
annotation <- data.frame(condition=coldata$condition, row.names=rownames(coldata))
pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix, annotation_col=annotation, annotation_row=annotation,
         main='Sample-to-Sample Distance Heatmap',
         filename='African_sample_distance_heatmap.png', width=8,height=7)

############################################################
# Step 9: Set reference group and fit exploratory limma model
############################################################
# In class: dds$condition <- relevel(dds$condition, ref='Neuron'); dds <- DESeq(dds)
coldata$condition <- relevel(coldata$condition, ref='Control')
design <- model.matrix(~condition, data=coldata)
fit <- lmFit(vsd, design)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

############################################################
# Step 10: Check available comparisons (like resultsNames(dds))
############################################################
colnames(design)
levels(coldata$condition)

############################################################
# Step 11: Extract results for sPE vs Control
############################################################
res <- topTable(fit, coef='conditionsPE', number=Inf, sort.by='P')
# limma logFC>0: higher expression in sPE relative to Control.
head(res)

############################################################
# Step 12: Order results by adjusted p-value
############################################################
res <- res[order(res$adj.P.Val), , drop=FALSE]
head(res)

############################################################
# Step 13: Clean table without NA adjusted p-values
############################################################
res_clean <- res[!is.na(res$adj.P.Val), , drop=FALSE]
head(res_clean)

############################################################
# Step 14: Log fold changes (no DESeq2 apeglm shrinkage)
############################################################
# In class: lfcShrink(dds, ... type='apeglm')
# NOT possible on a normalized expression-only matrix.
# limma already provides logFC from the exploratory linear model.
res_shrunk_df <- res_clean  # Class-style name; NOT actually shrunk!

############################################################
# Step 15: Add human gene IDs and symbols
############################################################
res_shrunk_df$gene_id <- rownames(res_shrunk_df)
res_shrunk_df$ensembl_id <- sub('\\$.*$', '', res_shrunk_df$gene_id)
res_shrunk_df$gene_symbol <- sub('^.*\\$', '', res_shrunk_df$gene_id)
res_shrunk_df$gene_symbol[res_shrunk_df$gene_symbol==''] <- res_shrunk_df$ensembl_id[res_shrunk_df$gene_symbol=='']
head(res_shrunk_df[,c('gene_id','gene_symbol','logFC','adj.P.Val')])

############################################################
# Step 16: Define significance groups (same thresholds as class)
############################################################
res_shrunk_df$significance <- 'Not Significant'
res_shrunk_df$significance[res_shrunk_df$adj.P.Val<0.05 & res_shrunk_df$logFC>1] <- 'Upregulated'
res_shrunk_df$significance[res_shrunk_df$adj.P.Val<0.05 & res_shrunk_df$logFC< -1] <- 'Downregulated'
table(res_shrunk_df$significance)

############################################################
# Step 17: Extract significant genes only
############################################################
sig_only <- subset(res_shrunk_df, adj.P.Val<0.05 & abs(logFC)>1)
nrow(sig_only)
head(sig_only)

############################################################
# Step 18: Select top up- and downregulated genes for labels
############################################################
res_shrunk_df$baseMean_log10 <- log10(rowMeans(normalized_counts[res_shrunk_df$gene_id,,drop=FALSE])+1)
up_sig <- subset(sig_only, logFC>1)
down_sig <- subset(sig_only, logFC< -1)
top_up <- head(up_sig[order(up_sig$adj.P.Val),,drop=FALSE],5)
top_down <- head(down_sig[order(down_sig$adj.P.Val),,drop=FALSE],5)
top_labels <- rbind(top_up, top_down)

############################################################
# Step 19: MA-style plot (mean normalized expression vs logFC)
############################################################
p_ma <- ggplot(res_shrunk_df, aes(baseMean_log10, logFC, color=significance)) +
 geom_point(alpha=.6) + geom_hline(yintercept=c(-1,1),linetype='dashed') +
 labs(x='log10(Mean Normalized Expression + 1)',y='limma log2 fold change',
      title='MA-style Plot: African sPE vs Control (exploratory)') + theme_minimal()
print(p_ma)
ggsave('African_MA_exploratory.png',p_ma,width=8,height=6,dpi=300)

############################################################
# Step 20: Volcano plot with all genes
############################################################
res_shrunk_df$neglog10padj <- -log10(pmax(res_shrunk_df$adj.P.Val,.Machine$double.xmin))
top_labels$neglog10padj <- -log10(pmax(top_labels$adj.P.Val,.Machine$double.xmin))
p_volcano <- ggplot(res_shrunk_df,aes(logFC,neglog10padj,color=significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha=.6) + geom_vline(xintercept=c(-1,1),linetype='dashed') +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(.05),linetype='dashed') +
  geom_text_repel(data=top_labels,aes(label=gene_symbol),size=3,max.overlaps=20) +
  xlab('Log2 Fold Change (sPE vs Control)') + ylab('-Log10 Adjusted P-value') +
  ggtitle('Volcano Plot: African sPE vs Control (exploratory)') + theme_minimal()
print(p_volcano)
ggsave('African_volcano_exploratory.png',p_volcano,width=9,height=6,dpi=300)

############################################################
# Step 21: Volcano plot significant genes only
############################################################
if (nrow(sig_only)>0) {
 sig_only$neglog10padj <- -log10(pmax(sig_only$adj.P.Val,.Machine$double.xmin))
 p_sig <- ggplot(sig_only,aes(logFC,neglog10padj,color=significance)) +
   geom_point(alpha=.7) + ggtitle('Significant Genes Only (exploratory)') + theme_minimal()
 print(p_sig)
 ggsave('African_volcano_significant_only.png',p_sig,width=8,height=6,dpi=300)
}

############################################################
# Step 22: View top significant genes
############################################################
top20_sig <- head(sig_only[order(sig_only$adj.P.Val),,drop=FALSE],20)
print(top20_sig[,c('gene_symbol','logFC','adj.P.Val'),drop=FALSE])

############################################################
# Step 23: Heatmap of top significant genes
############################################################
if (nrow(sig_only)>0) {
 top_genes <- head(rownames(sig_only),min(30,nrow(sig_only)))
 mat <- vsd[top_genes,,drop=FALSE]
 mat_scaled <- t(scale(t(mat)))
 mat_scaled[!is.finite(mat_scaled)] <- 0
 row_labels <- sig_only[top_genes,'gene_symbol']
 rownames(mat_scaled) <- make.unique(row_labels)
 pheatmap(mat_scaled,annotation_col=annotation,main='Top Significant Genes Heatmap',
          filename='African_top_genes_heatmap.png',width=9,height=8)
} else {
 message('No genes met the selected thresholds; no significant-gene heatmap saved.')
}

############################################################
# Step 24: Save results
############################################################
write.csv(res_shrunk_df,'African_sPE_vs_Control_ALL_genes_EXPLORATORY.csv',row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(sig_only,'African_sPE_vs_Control_significant_genes_EXPLORATORY.csv',row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(top20_sig,'African_sPE_vs_Control_top20_EXPLORATORY.csv',row.names=FALSE)

############################################################
# Step 25: Extra protein-assignment plots (FLT1, LEP, IL3RA)
############################################################
for (gene in c('FLT1','LEP','IL3RA')) {
 idx <- which(sub('^.*\\$','',rownames(vsd))==gene)
 if (length(idx)!=1) { message('Skipping ',gene,': gene symbol not unique/present.'); next }
 gene_df <- data.frame(condition=coldata$condition, expression=as.numeric(vsd[idx,]))
 p_gene <- ggplot(gene_df,aes(condition,expression,color=condition)) +
   geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA,width=.5) + geom_jitter(width=.1,size=2) +
   xlab('Condition') + ylab('log2(normalized expression + 1)') +
   ggtitle(paste(gene,'expression: African ancestry')) + theme_minimal()
 print(p_gene)
 ggsave(paste0('African_',gene,'_expression.png'),p_gene,width=5,height=4,dpi=300)
}

message('Completed exploratory analysis. For formal DESeq2, obtain raw integer counts.')
```
